entries.name: Governed Codex bootstrap foundation
entries.summary: The repository provides research-first canonicalization, maintained knowledge navigation, owner-scoped orchestration, bounded coordination, evidence-based testing, reconciliation, and continuity tooling.

entries.name: First separate owner activation
